text: In accordance with Section 9.A. of the Consolidated Rules of Procedure for the Property Standards Committee, as amended, each Panel shall adopt a schedule of meetings to hear appeals for each year. The Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel's meetings will be held remotely until further notice.

The Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel approved the following meeting dates for 2021: - Monday, October 25, 2021 at 1:30 p.m. - Monday, November 22, 2021 at 1:30 p.m. - Monday, December 13, 2021 at 1:30 p.m.
